{{Quote|Apparently this part of space is known for causing hallucinations.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>}}
The '''Kathol Rift''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was difficult to maneuver through, as it consisted of a dense accretion of nebulaic material. It was home to both the [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] monks, who were able to easily navigate through it, and the [[DarkStryder]]. It was believed to be a construct of the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]],<ref name="Atlas" /> although another source had it as the result of a [[launch gate]] [[Rift Disaster|explosion]] caused by a [[Unidentified Dark Jedi (Kathol system)|Dark Jedi]].<ref name="TKR" />

The Rift was known to induce [[Hallucination/Legends|hallucinations]] in those who traveled within the vicinity, with the effect often amplified in [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] beings. Common hallucinations included [[Spider/Legends|spiders]] and other [[Arthropod/Legends|arthropods]].
